description: This Java source file defines the class JsonVariable, which extends BaseVariable and represents a variable that stores JSON objects within a code generation framework. It provides methods for encoding and decoding JSON data in C and Java, and maintains internal state relevant to JSON handling.

classes.name: JsonVariable
classes.description: Represents a JSON object variable in code generation, supporting encoding and decoding for C and Java target code, and tracking internal states such as double pointer dereferencing.

methods.name: JsonVariable
methods.description: Constructor initializing the JsonVariable with an ICJsonVariable bean.

methods.name: resolveReferences
methods.description: Method overridden to resolve references; no specific implementation needed for JSON variables.

methods.name: isPtr
methods.description: Indicates whether the variable is a pointer, returns true for JSON variables.

methods.name: isString
methods.description: Indicates whether the variable is a string, returns false for JSON objects.

methods.name: getCtype
methods.description: Returns the C data type as 'cJSON' for the variable.

methods.name: getJsonKey
methods.description: Returns the JSON key name used in serialization.

methods.name: setDoubleDeref
methods.description: Sets internal flag to indicate double pointer dereference in native decoding.

methods.name: getNativeEncodeLines
methods.description: Generates C code for encoding the variable into a cJSON structure.

methods.name: getNativeDecodeLines
methods.description: Generates C code for decoding the variable from a cJSON structure.

methods.name: getJavaEncodeLines
methods.description: Generates Java code for encoding the variable into a JSON object.

methods.name: getJavaDecodeLines
methods.description: Generates Java code for decoding the variable from a JSON object.

methods.name: getJavaIpcObjectType
methods.description: Returns the IPC object type as 'JsonIPC'.
